title: W11416787 — Service Mode entry
description: Three-button Service Mode entry (any buttons except POWER) × 3 rounds within 8 seconds; LCD shows service technician text.

source.manualTitle: Whirlpool & Maytag 4.7/5.3 cu ft Top Load Washer (Direct Drive)

steps.title: Enter Service Mode
steps.body: Washer in standby (plugged in, all indicators off). Choose any three buttons except POWER and remember their order. Within 8 seconds: press and release button 1, then 2, then 3 — repeat that same 3-button sequence two more times (3 rounds total). Success: LCD displays "This area is for Service Technicians only" with navigational instructions. Navigate Select/Enter to reach Service Diagnostics, Component Activation, and Sensor Feedback.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Select any three (3) buttons (except POWER)... Press and Release the 1st, 2nd, 3rd selected button; Repeat this 3 button sequence 2 more times.
